description: This file defines a DTMF aggregation processor class for converting keypad inputs into transcription frames, handling input frames, timeouts, and termination conditions for downstream processing.

classes.name: DTMFAggregator
classes.description: A processor that aggregates DTMF keypad inputs into sequences and converts them into transcription frames for downstream processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DTMF aggregator with optional timeout, termination digit, and prefix.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the aggregation task.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling start, end, cancel, and DTMF input frames.

methods.name: _handle_dtmf_frame
methods.description: Handles individual DTMF input frames, updating aggregation and checking for flush conditions.

methods.name: _create_aggregation_task
methods.description: Creates a background task for timeout-based flushing.

methods.name: _aggregation_task_handler
methods.description: Background task that waits for digit events or timeout to trigger flushing.

methods.name: _flush_aggregation
methods.description: Flushes the current DTMF sequence as a transcription frame.
